Container.Name: kardo
Container.Overview: Self-hosted spaced-repetition flashcards. Import Anki .apkg decks (subdecks, card styling, images, audio, cloze) or CSV files and study them from any browser, or add Kardo to your iPhone or Android Home Screen so it opens like an app. One small container, one SQLite file, no accounts and no outbound connections. Includes statistics, practice quizzes, a card browser, one-tap backup and an optional SQL practice lab. Kardo has no login of its own: keep it on your LAN or tailnet, or behind an authenticating reverse proxy. Not affiliated with Anki.
